description.value:
Frequency once per week

Requirement Ashroad Circuit membership or good standing, per §6.

Call in a favor. Choose one: what the Manifest knows about one Anchor, creature, or haunting; a Circuit safehouse in this settlement, secure for one week; or a second Wardbreaker of up to your level, who rides with you for one job and expects you to ride for them later. The Circuit keeps accounts, and the GM may call yours in.

cinderfall.incomplete: Zero stated numbers and no direct pf2e precedent of the same effect-class found shipping rules: [] despite a search; per this pass's discipline, absent a citation this defaults to INCOMPLETE rather than SKIP. (a GM-adjudicated homebrew-faction favor system: intel, a safehouse, or another Wardbreaker's help for one job.)
